essence: An accomplished mantra-priest should then perform the prescribed ritual applications.
One should offer one thousand and one oblations for seven days to pacify spirits.
Performing oblations for four days produces the pacification of fever.
A mantra-reciter becomes endowed with wealth and grain within a year.
Having offered twelve thousand oblations, one becomes beloved by all people.
